documents.title: UGA Guidance on Acceptable Use of AI (companion to Policy 01.07.005)
documents.summary: UGA's guidance companion to Policy 01.07.005 welcomes AI use across teaching, research and operations as long as it is responsible, lawful and data-safe. It covers data privacy, approved tools, accountability and copyright, and does not address course-level student rules.
documents.stance_why: The preamble says 'The UGA community is encouraged to explore these important tools and to use them responsibly', and the rest sets conditions (law, privacy, approved tools, accountability). documents.summary: A CTL guide that helps instructors design their own AI policy using the five-level AI Assessment Scale, a traffic-light chart, declaration and reflection practices, and three sample syllabus policies from permissive to prohibitive. It sets no single rule and leaves each instructor to choose.
